::: {#rem-double-inclusion}
#### The shape of a set equality proof

By @thm-double-inclusion, a proof of $A = B$ has two parts,
each a subset proof (@rem-subset-template):

> | ($\subseteq$) Suppose $a \in A$.
> | $\vdots$
> | Therefore $a \in B$.
> |
> | ($\supseteq$) Suppose $a \in B$.
> | $\vdots$
> | Therefore $a \in A$.
> |
> | So $A = B$.

This is the "if and only if" outline of @rem-iff-template,
applied to $a \in A$ and $a \in B$.

:::
